1.consolidated_definition: Hacer movimientos poco usuales una persona que tenga flexibilidad en los músculos y coyunturas. Hacer acrobacia.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To perform unusual movements with a person who has flexibility in their muscles and joints. To engage in acrobatics.
